info.title: Redis Agent Memory API
info.description:
API for storing, retrieving, and searching Redis Agent Memory session memory and long-term memory.

Authentication depends on your deployment. Use the credential issued for your Agent Memory service or store. For self-managed deployments, see the self-managed Agent Memory guide for authentication options.

post.description: Creates long-term memories in bulk. A memoryId that already exists is rejected for that record (reported in errors) and the stored memory is left unchanged; change a memory with UpdateLongTermMemory. Records without namespaceId stay un-namespaced. Automatic routing does not place them in a shared namespace. An explicit namespaceId must pass destination admission and is never rerouted. Admission failures are reported per record in errors.

post.description: Moves long-term memories to an explicit namespaceId, or automatically routes a memory that is already in a shared namespace when namespaceId is omitted. Personal and un-namespaced memories are not automatic-routing candidates and keep their current placement with a per-item error. If routing is disabled or no shared destination qualifies, the memory also keeps its current placement and receives a per-item error. An explicit destination must pass admission and is never rerouted. Returns 409 when the explicit destination is archived; automatic routing and admission failures are reported per item in errors.

parameters.name: memoryType
parameters.description:
Identifier of a long-term memory type.

Built-in types include `semantic`, `episodic`, `message`, and `session_summary`.
The legacy `session_summary_view` name remains reserved. Search filters for either
summary name match both, except on stores with an existing custom `session_summary`
type, where each name retains its separate meaning.
Stores may also register custom memory types; this open string accepts any
registered type name.

Constraints: 1-64 chars, must start with a letter, followed by letters, digits,
underscores, or dashes.

schema.description:
Identifier of a long-term memory type.

Built-in types include `semantic`, `episodic`, `message`, and `session_summary`.
The legacy `session_summary_view` name remains reserved. Search filters for either
summary name match both, except on stores with an existing custom `session_summary`
type, where each name retains its separate meaning.
Stores may also register custom memory types; this open string accepts any
registered type name.

Constraints: 1-64 chars, must start with a letter, followed by letters, digits,
underscores, or dashes.
